prerequisites: Successful completion of modules to be completed according to the study plan in the 1st and 2nd semesters
Fundamentals of Process Engineering and Plastics Processing (recommended)

learning_outcomes.text: Students can describe basic plastics processing methods and assign typical plastic products to the respective manufacturing processes.
They are able to calculate simple physical processes during processing.
They are able to select suitable plastics based on their properties for the respective product and its manufacturing process.
They are able to design and construct products and processes in a plastics-appropriate manner.

syllabus_topics: Extruder types and their conveying characteristics
Spun fibre lines and related processes
Drive systems of injection molding machines
Economic importance compared to metal die casting
Injection molding of reactive molding compounds
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module final examination. The module is weighted by the number of its credit points (factor: 1).
